UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, on-distribution outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the AI slop aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx.
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly fulfills all key functionalities: Login (NIK+password), Register with Admin approval status, Admin CRUD personnel (16 personnel default seed), Drag reorder for personnel rows in shift schedule table, Manual shift editor + Auto-generate patterns (3/2, 3/3, 2/2), Excel import/export + PDF Landscape export, Leave conflict validation rule (Min 2 Pagi + 2 Siang + 1 Malam per day), Notification bell system for both Admin & Personil, Monthly summary report, Change log, and Site Content Editor + Primary Color Accent Picker.
Implement dynamic CSS variables for the Admin custom primary color picker so changing the accent color updates all buttons, focus rings, status highlights, and charts seamlessly.
Ensure dark mode elegant moon-blue theme is auto-detected from system preferences and manual toggle works seamlessly.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes matching the test_ids schema provided in this file.
